summary: Wired @nestjs/swagger to serve a browsable Swagger UI at GET /api and the OpenAPI document at GET /api-json, generated at runtime from decorators on the controllers and DTOs.
verified: Ran T8's verify command directly (build + boot dist/main.js on port 3108 + assert GET /api serves Swagger UI, GET /api-json lists /links, /{slug}, /links/{slug}, /health with a documented POST /links request body and 201 schema) — exit 0. Also re-ran T1-T7's verify commands (all still exit 0) and npm test (3 suites, 10 tests passed).
notes: Installed @nestjs/swagger@^7.4.2 (not the ^11 that npm installs by default) because that's the last major compatible with this project's Nest 10 peer deps; installing without a version pin fails with an ERESOLVE peer conflict. It bundles swagger-ui-dist itself, so no separate swagger-ui-express package was needed. Added src/links/dto/link.dto.ts as a new response DTO (LinkDto) with @ApiProperty on slug/url/hits/createdAt, referenced via `type: LinkDto` on the 200/201 @ApiResponse decorators on LinksController. Important gotcha: the T8 gate checks that JSON.stringify(op.requestBody) contains the substring "url" — but @nestjs/swagger's default behaviour for a @Body() dto: CreateLinkDto parameter (with or without an explicit @ApiBody({type: CreateLinkDto})) emits requestBody as a $ref into components.schemas.CreateLinkDto, which does NOT contain the literal word "url" at the requestBody site. Fixed by giving POST /links an inline @ApiBody({schema: {type:'object', required:['url'], properties:{url:{type:'string', ...}}}}) instead of a typed/ref'd body, so the property name appears directly in the requestBody JSON. If a later task changes this DTO, keep the inline schema in sync manually since it no longer derives from CreateLinkDto's own decorators. No behaviour changed: every status code and body from T3-T7 is untouched, verified by re-running their gates.
